title: HB316 (2026 Regular): AN ACT relating to local firearms control ordinances.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Introduced, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/26RS/hb316/orig_bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 3306666))
provenance.note: As-filed (BR 1723, 1/12/2026); no passage vote in the record. Section 2 (KRS 65.1591, peer support privilege) only changes wording and is not a gun part. Section 3 drops the KRS 65.870 safe-harbor sentence from KRS 237.115(2)(b) (struck text in brackets); the quoted sentence is unchanged by the bill and is shown as context.

operative_text:
Section 1 (KRS 65.870, repealed and reenacted): Notwithstanding KRS 237.104, a city, county, urban-county government, charter county, consolidated local government, or unified local government may enact ordinances regulating the manufacture, sale, purchase, taxation, transfer, ownership, possession, carrying, storage, or transportation of firearms, ammunition, components of firearms, components of ammunition, firearms accessories, or combination thereof.
Section 3 (KRS 237.115): (2) (b) The statute or ordinance shall exempt any building used for public housing by private persons, highway rest areas, firing ranges, and private dwellings owned, leased, or controlled by that unit of government from any restriction on the carrying or possession of deadly weapons.
